definitions.gloss: to pile up, to build up

examples.japanese: お{金|かね}が{溜|た}まった。
{仕事|しごと}が{溜|た}まっている。

notes:
{溜|た}まる is a godan verb meaning to accumulate, collect, or pile up over time.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive)
- Pair: {溜|た}める (transitive: to save up, accumulate)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- お{金|かね}が{溜|た}まる: money accumulates
- {疲|つか}れが{溜|た}まる: fatigue builds up
- ストレスが{溜|た}まる: stress builds up
- {仕事|しごと}が{溜|た}まる: work piles up
- {埃|ほこり}が{溜|た}まる: dust collects
- {水|みず}が{溜|た}まる: water pools/collects

NUANCE:
Often implies gradual, unintentional accumulation, and frequently has a negative connotation (stress, work, fatigue piling up).
